title: SCANG F-16 mishap support
description: U.S. Airmen assigned to the 169th Fighter Wing at McEntire Joint National Guard Base, S.C., respond to the area where an F-16 Fighting Falcon fighter jet from the South Carolina Air National Guard crashed in Louisville, Georgia, June 8, 2016. Two SCANG F-16s collided mid-air during routine night flying training in the Jefferson County area, June 7, 2016. Both pilots ejected safely.
